verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Column serves an llms.txt at docs.column.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a Column Documentation header). Its docs are also published as raw markdown pages under /markdown/, which an agent can ingest directly, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is available. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on pointing agents at these resources (e.g., an agent-usage page or llms-full.txt), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually using them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.column.com/llms.txt # Column Documentation
Column's API is defined by an OpenAPI spec (also available as JSON).
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.column.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
